implementation_assumptions.energy: E_nom=100 MVA*4.52 s=452 MJ=125.56 kWh is conditional on the converter MVA basis. At SOC 0.1..0.9 usable energy is 361.6 MJ; initial 0.5 permits only 180.8 MJ discharge before losses.
implementation_assumptions.network: Balanced constant-PQ two-bus high-voltage root; X/R=10, source=1.05 pu are synthetic.
implementation_assumptions.controller: P priority, first-order sampled load smoothing, SOC recovery, algebraic Q droop and shared P-Q MVA circle; no switching/current/delay/stability dynamics.
implementation_assumptions.load: Synthetic facility-PCC load, not the confidential North American client trace; no separate transformer/UPS dynamics.
implementation_assumptions.flicker: Voltage excursion is not Pst. Import external validated-meter results with case/window/channel provenance; importer cannot validate the meter itself.
implementation_assumptions.sizing: Finite discrete candidates and explicit synthetic thresholds; no procurement recommendation, compliance finding or minimum-cost optimum.
